title: CMS Open Payments (openpaymentsdata.cms.gov)
questions: payments from drug and device companies to doctors in a state
which companies paid the most to physicians
payments to a specific physician by NPI

manual.how: Open the JSON links in INSTRUCTIONS.md (filters applied, 500 rows a page), save each under the shown name and upload; or search https://openpaymentsdata.cms.gov/ (Search > by physician, hospital or company) and export the results. Full-year payment files are several GB: download them from the dataset page only on a computer with room, then upload a filtered extract.

cache.why: Filtered queries are small; every dataset is republished when CMS refreshes the program years (all were last modified 2026-06-30). data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: Open Payments datasets carry the licence https://www.usa.gov/government-works (U.S. government work, public domain, 17 U.S.C. 105) in the CMS metastore.

notices: Open Payments records are reported by manufacturers and group purchasing organizations and published as reported (recipients may dispute them); a payment does not by itself indicate a conflict of interest or wrongdoing.
citation: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Open Payments: {dataset}, openpaymentsdata.cms.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.

audit_hooks.why: Reports using Open Payments must say that payments are self-reported by industry and do not imply wrongdoing.

clarify: Which program year(s)? Each year is a separate file; the latest published year is 2025 (published June 2026).
General payments only, or also research payments and ownership interests? They are separate datasets and are not additive with the summaries.
Physicians only, or also nurse practitioners and other non-physician practitioners (reported since program year 2021) and teaching hospitals?
